scenario_description:
Objective: Capture a one-day home-internet retention promo that could lower the next bill while leaving the existing service unchanged.
Emerging Need: Early notice only hints at a possible offer; later records confirm the active account, ordinary monthly price, exact promo terms, and a same-afternoon submission window.
Decision Context: The subscription workpad has the billing-support address and current-plan constraint, so the useful response can reference the right account details without choosing a new package or payment.
Consequence: If the window is used, an optional credit may apply; if ignored or discovered after closure, service and payments continue normally.

parameter.subject: CityLoop customer thank-you offer coming today
parameter.body: A limited customer thank-you offer will be posted later today for some Madison residential internet accounts. Eligibility, pricing, and the submission route will be announced in a follow-up notice.

parameter.title: Clinic appointment across town
parameter.description: Personal appointment; limited ability to handle account errands during the visit.

parameter.subject: HOME48 rate-match details for existing customers
parameter.body: Starting at 1:00 p.m. CT today, active residential internet customers may request a 12-month $48/month retention rate on their current speed tier while today's allocation lasts. Include the current monthly charge and account nickname. Requests must arrive by 4:30 p.m. CT. No equipment change is required for a current-speed match; the portal banner will list available submission methods.

parameter.content: Just passed the CityLoop pop-up downtown. Their HOME48 sign says billing-support emails count today because the portal is backed up, as long as the email is received before 4:30. No phone call needed.

parameter.subject: HOME48 daily allocation closed
parameter.body: Today's HOME48 rate-match allocation was fully claimed at 4:30 p.m. CT. New requests received after that time will receive only the standard plan-review options until another promotion is announced.
